svg.aria-label: A load and a store through the LSU
svg.text: A load and a store through the LSU
Still frames, one per cycle. Filled parts are active in that frame; faint parts are idle. Latencies are measured; the order inside a cycle is a reading.
Virtual address bits the L1D path uses
3 clk to a pointer chase, 4 to an ALU, 5 to a SIMD register
2 per clk, address and data uops; 60 entry queue of 32 B slots
47:14, folded to the 8 b utag; also the dTLB tag

The set index lies inside the page offset, so the lookup starts before translation. Bits 7:6 belong to both the set and the bank field: the 16 banks span four lines of a set, and two loads to one bank in a cycle collide unless they share an element.
c0 select the oldest ready of 48
c1 base + offset, same page? PC pair lookup; a hit waits
for its store (miss costs a 25 clk flush)
c1 to c2 the utag fold of VA 47:14 picks the way
c2 bank read, 16 B; SQ CAM matches older stores;
c3 PA tag confirms → chase. A bypass feeds the next
c4 ALU, c5 SIMD. A store address 2 to 4 clk late fails
STA: AGU, dTLB and utag as for a load; address and a 32 B slot land in the SQ and
wake the loads waiting on this store
STD: reads the source register at issue and writes 16 B lanes into the slot; a
after retire: the oldest slot commits over two 16 B paths, 2 per clk, 32 B/clk into the
miss: a store-miss entry fetches the line for ownership while younger hits write
ahead; a full-line stream skips the fetch
two 16 B requests at cache access
cleared when the line leaves the L1D
x86 ordering for Rosetta, by control bit
loads still issue out of order
